high_level_description: The image shows a man standing outdoors in front of a large blue sign with the word "intel" written on it in white letters. The man is wearing a dark gray vest over a white shirt and is holding a wafer of CPU tiles for the Intel Core Ultra series 3, code-named Panther Lake. He is also wearing white gloves to handle the wafer carefully. The setting appears to be outside an Intel facility, as indicated by the sign behind him. The background includes a modern building with glass windows and some greenery.
